blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua ordered on Tuesday the lifting of the four-day onsite work arrangement adopted by Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) ministries and other agencies since March 11 as part of austerity measures in response to the energy crisis triggered by the conflict in the Middle East. In a memorandum issued today and signed by BARMM Senior Minister Abunawas Maslamama, Macacua ordered all ministries, offices, and agencies under the Bangsamoro regional government to resume regular working hours beginning Monday, November 16. “In the interest of public service and as agreed during the First Regular […]...
